name: Lyse AS
note: Norwegian energy and telecoms group (brands Altibox, ice, Lyse), headquartered in Stavanger. The club's partner page says Lyse is wholly owned by 15 municipalities; the Brønnøysund register classifies LYSE AS (orgnr 980 001 482) under sector code 1520, kommunalt eide aksjeselskaper (municipally owned limited companies).
